violation_type.title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Medication Records (26 TAC §746.801(7))
violation_type.short_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Medication Records
violation_type.typical_finding: The operation did not have medication logs available for review. In one classroom for two children, observed a staff member has documented the name of the medication and the time given on an infant daily report which is sent home to the parent.

finding_variants.text: The operation did not have medication logs available for review. In one classroom for two children, observed a staff member has documented the name of the medication and the time given on an infant daily report which is sent home to the parent.
Multiple medications were observed to be unlabeled at the operation. One medication was observed to be more than 3/4 used, unlabeled, and not logged.
The medication log has not been updated for a child who has been given medication.
The child's medication records were not available.
The medication logs are not being properly maintained as they are signed by the parent but there is no signature to verify if the employee provided the medication as requested by the parent.

Based on findings obtained during the course of the abuse/neglect investigation, information was obtained showing that the operation was not using a medication log to show how/when/ and what medications were brought to the day care daily. They also had no report to indicate when, where, how, or dosage of medications as they were given to children.
